method: Original frozen universe and time grid; positive 7-day mean funding top K with original tie ordering; classify each selected coin-period against provider-declared Gate L2 availability over [t,t+3 days).
limitations: Provider metadata is an upper bound, not verified continuous data, access, identity, tradability or fills.
No Gate metadata does not rule out MEXC or another venue.
Selected coin-periods are not trades; turnover and transaction costs are not calculated.
Original full-universe gross annualization is an unexecutable counterfactual, not expected net returns.
Matching row count and aggregate statistics do not prove the database snapshot is byte-identical.
